text: FoolWidget Inc. offers a 14-day money-back guarantee on all hardware products. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the item is returned to our warehouse.
Our standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the US. International shipping is 10-21 business days. Express shipping (1-2 days) is available for an additional $15.
FoolWidget supports 32 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Mandarin Chinese, and Hindi. Customer support is available in 12 languages 24/7.
The FoolWidget Pro plan costs $99/month and includes unlimited API calls, priority support, and access to advanced analytics. Annual billing saves 20%.
To cancel your subscription, navigate to Account Settings > Billing > Cancel. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period. There are no early-termination fees.
